title: Jobber Pricing 2026: Plans, Per-User Cost & Fees
description: Jobber costs $29-$399/mo billed annually ($49-$499 monthly). Team tiers, extra users, add-ons, card fees and contract terms, checked Oct 31, 2026.
h1: Jobber pricing: what each plan really costs
body:
Looking up the Jobber price? Here's every number Jobber publishes, taken from its own pricing page on 2026-10-31, plus what it works out to per year for a solo operator and for crews of 2-5, 10 and 15. All prices are in USD and exclude sales tax where applicable, as Jobber's page says. Anything Jobber doesn't publish is marked unknown.

Jobber plans and prices (2026)

Jobber has four plans (Core, Connect, Grow and Plus) and three ways to pay: annual (prepaid for the year), monthly with a 1-year commitment, and monthly with no commitment. Prices below are for the smallest team size on each plan.

PlanUsers includedBilled annuallyMonthly, 1-year commitmentMonthly, no commitment
Core1$29/mo$39/mo$49/mo
Connect1$99/mo$119/mo$139/mo
Grow1$149/mo$169/mo$199/mo
Plus5$399/mo$439/mo$499/mo

Promo update: until Oct 30, 2026, Jobber showed a first-year discount on annual plans (for example Core at $21/mo). On 2026-10-31 the pricing page no longer shows that offer, so the prices above are the standard list prices.

Team-size tiers: what 5, 10 and 15 users cost

Connect, Grow and Plus are also sold in bundles with more users included. These are Jobber's published prices per month:

Plan and usersBilled annuallyMonthly, 1-year commitmentMonthly, no commitment
Connect, 5 users$149$169$199
Connect, 10 users$229$259$299
Connect, 15 users$299$339$399
Grow, 5 users$229$259$299
Grow, 10 users$299$349$399
Grow, 15 users$399$429$499
Plus, 5 users$399$439$499
Plus, 10 users$449$499$599
Plus, 15 users$529$599$699

Core only comes as a 1-user plan. Teams of 16 or more are sent to sales, so that pricing is unknown. Jobber counts a user as "anyone who accesses your account at the office or in the field to view or manage the team's schedule". Extra users are $29/mo each. The page doesn't say whether that fee changes with the billing option.

Extra users vs. the next tier

Because extra users are $29/mo, it's sometimes cheaper to jump to the next team tier. Using annual prices, and assuming the $29 fee applies on annual billing:

  • Connect: 2 users is $99 + $29 = $128/mo. 3 users would be $157/mo, which costs more than the 5-user tier at $149/mo.
  • Grow: 2 users is $178/mo and 3 users is $207/mo. 4 users would be $236/mo, which costs more than the 5-user tier at $229/mo.

What Jobber costs per year

These totals are list price × 12. They leave out add-ons, card fees and sales tax:

  • Solo operator, Core: $348/yr billed annually, $468/yr on the 1-year monthly option, or $588/yr with no commitment.
  • Solo operator, Connect (adds routing, reminders and QuickBooks sync): $1,188/yr billed annually or $1,668/yr with no commitment.
  • Crew of 5, Connect: $1,788/yr billed annually ($29.80 per user per month) or $2,388/yr with no commitment.
  • Crew of 5, Grow: $2,748/yr billed annually or $3,588/yr with no commitment.
  • Crew of 10, Grow: $3,588/yr billed annually or $4,788/yr with no commitment.
  • Crew of 15, Plus: $6,348/yr billed annually or $8,388/yr with no commitment.

What each plan adds

This comes from the feature table on Jobber's pricing page (2026-10-31):

  • Core: client manager (CRM), client hub, online booking and request forms, quotes, invoices, online card and bank payments, Tap to Pay, a website, basic reporting (insights, financial, client and work reports), the app marketplace and 1-on-1 support.
  • Connect adds: automated client reminders and notifications, routing and GPS tracking, checklists, time and expense tracking, automatic payments, automated quote and invoice follow-ups, QuickBooks Online and Xero sync, Zapier and Gusto, plus 2 onboarding sessions (up to 2 hours).
  • Grow adds: two-way text messaging, a custom automation builder, Find a Time scheduling suggestions, job costing, automatic (geofenced) time tracking, optional line items and markups on quotes, quotes and invoices with images, and 3 onboarding sessions (up to 3 hours). The 14-day free trial runs on Grow.
  • Plus adds: crew scheduling, crew time tracking, job profit alerts, a files and media library, supplier invoice scanning, receipt capture, a custom report builder, revenue goals, API access with a tour, Premium Support, data import and unlimited onboarding. Pipeline, Marketing Suite and the AI Receptionist are included.

Add-ons and fees on top of the plan price

  • Add-ons (included on Plus, extra on Core, Connect and Grow): Marketing Suite $99/mo, AI Receptionist $29/mo, Pipeline $49/mo.
  • Online card payments: 2.9% + 30¢. Tap to Pay: 2.7% + 30¢. Bank (ACH): 1%. Instant payouts: an extra 1%. The rates are the same on every plan. For scale, $10,000/mo collected online by card in 50 payments would cost about $305 in fees (2.9% of $10,000 plus 50 × 30¢).
  • Reviews appear on Grow and Plus quotes only when the Reviews add-on is enabled. Its price isn't on the pricing page (unknown).

Contract, cancellation and the free trial

  • No commitment: cancel any time. The subscription ends at the end of the current billing period.
  • Monthly, 1-year commitment: there's a 12-month minimum. If you cancel early, you keep being billed monthly until the 12 months are up.
  • Annual: you pay for the full year up front. If you cancel, you keep access until the term ends, but the payment is non-refundable.
  • All subscriptions auto-renew unless you set them not to. You can upgrade any time and downgrade at the end of the billing cycle.
  • Free trial: 14 days with full access to Grow. No credit card is needed. If the trial runs out, Jobber says nothing is deleted.
  • Franchises and multi-location businesses can ask the Partnerships team for custom pricing.

Is Jobber worth the price? How it compares

  • One person: Jobber Core ($29/mo annually, $49 monthly) costs less than Housecall Pro Basic ($59 annually, $79 monthly). But Core doesn't include routing, automated reminders or QuickBooks sync. Housecall Pro Basic's feature list is in Housecall Pro pricing.
  • Five people: Jobber's 5-user Connect and Housecall Pro Essentials (5 users) both cost $149/mo billed annually. With no commitment, Jobber is $199 and Housecall Pro is $189. Kickserv Start includes 5 users for $60/mo billed annually (Kickserv's price as checked 2026-10-25), but charges 3.9% + 30¢ on most online card payments. See Jobber vs Housecall Pro and Kickserv.
  • Route businesses with big crews (pest, pool, lawn): GorillaDesk prices per route ($49/mo for the first route on Basic) with unlimited users. See GorillaDesk pricing.

faq: How much does Jobber cost per month?

As of 2026-10-31, Jobber's pricing page lists Core at $29/mo billed annually ($39/mo monthly with a 1-year commitment, $49/mo with no commitment), Connect at $99/$119/$139, Grow at $149/$169/$199 (each for 1 user) and Plus at $399/$439/$499 with 5 users included. Prices are in USD and exclude sales tax where applicable.
How much does Jobber charge per extra user?
Jobber lists additional users at $29/mo each. Connect, Grow and Plus are also sold as 5-, 10- and 15-user bundles. For example, 5-user Connect is $149/mo billed annually.
Does Jobber have a free trial?
Yes. Jobber's trial gives 14 days of full access to the Grow plan, and no credit card is needed.

Only on the monthly no-commitment option, where the subscription ends at the end of the billing period. The monthly 1-year commitment keeps billing until 12 months are up, and annual prepaid plans are non-refundable, though you keep access until the term ends.
What are Jobber's payment processing fees?
Jobber lists 2.9% + 30¢ for online card payments, 2.7% + 30¢ for Tap to Pay and 1% for bank (ACH) payments on every plan, plus an extra 1% for instant payouts (checked 2026-10-31).
Does Jobber Core include route optimization?
No. Jobber's feature table shows routing and GPS tracking on Connect, Grow and Plus, but not on Core.
Is the Jobber $21/mo promo still available?
No. The first-year discount on annual plans (Core at $21/mo) ran until Oct 30, 2026. On 2026-10-31, Jobber's pricing page showed only the standard prices.
